units: <cite ref="Shabbat 8a:7">Sabb. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ ע״י הדחק לא שמיה ת׳</he> use by force (with inconvenience) is not considered use (such as makes the place so utilized public ground for Sabbath purposes).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18:12">Num. R. s. 18<sup>8</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 16:6">Num. XVI, 6</cite>) <he>הרי לכם ת׳ החביב וכ׳</he> here is that service for you which is the choicest of all, the offering of frankincense &c.; Tanḥ. Kor. 5.
<cite ref="Numbers 16:6">Ib.</cite> <he>בשביל תִּשְׁמִישׁוֹ של עולם</he> for the service (benefit) of the world.

<cite ref="Megillah 26b:9">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ קדושה הוא ואסיר</he> it is an object used at a sacred function, and is therefore forbidden for profane use; <cite ref="Megillah 26b:10">ib.</cite> <he>ת׳ דת׳ הוא</he> it is an object subservient to an object which is used at a sacred function (e. g. a thing on which a sacred implement is laid); a. fr.—Pl. <he>תַּשְׁמִישִׁים</he>, <he>תַּשְׁמִישִׁין</he>.

<cite ref="Megillah 26b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>תַּשְׁמִישֵׁי מצוה נזרקין</he> things used for a religious ceremony may be thrown away (after having served their purpose); <he>תשמישי קדושה נגנזין</he> implements for sacred things must be stored away (v. <cite ref="C01120"><he>גָּנַז</he></cite>); <he>ואלו הן ת׳ מצוה סוכה וכ׳</he> these are implements for a religious ceremony: the Succah, the Lulab &c.; <he>ואלו הן ת׳ קדושה וכ׳</he> and these are sacred implements: boxes for sacred scrolls &c.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8a:5">Bekh. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שתַּשְׁמִישׁוֹ ביום</he> all animals which copulate in day time; a. v. fr.
